caption: The drawing depicts a horizontal decorative frieze with three distinct bands, using primarily green, red, black, and beige colors. The top band features a repeating pattern of stylized red flowers with yellow centers and black accents, each flower surrounded by green leaves and connected by thin winding stems on a white background. The middle band is composed of a repeating geometric meander or Greek key design in green with beige outlines and black borders. The bottom band presents a sequence of red circular floral or shell-like motifs with green leaves on a white background, outlined by two thin, parallel red and green lines above and below. Beneath the decorative bands, there is an area shaded in light green, suggesting a ground or base. Portions of the image show areas where surface material appears to be worn or missing, especially around the center of the bands. The background of the overall drawing is an off-white or light beige, and the artist's name, "Edward T. Jewett," is printed in small text on the lower right side.
title: Wall Painting
